theme: You suddenly have money. Should it even be invested — and what forces act on it?
content_rules_applied: No specific instrument, fund, or stock is ever named or recommended.
All tax/fee/regulatory points reflect Indian rules and carry 'verify current rate before relying on this'.
Max 2 technical terms per lesson, each defined in one plain sentence.
Every lesson ends in a practical action tied to a REAL fetchable data point.
No invented statistics, no fear-based language.

lessons.title: ₹10,000 aaye — kharch, bachao, ya badhao?
lessons.subtitle: The spend / save / invest fork
lessons.situation: Account mein achanak ₹10,000 aaye — bonus ya freelance ka payment. Dil khush, aur saamne ek sale ka notification.

myth.lie: Paisa aate hi turant 'invest' kar dena hi samajhdari hai.
myth.truth: Pehla sawaal 'kahan' nahi — 'kab chahiye' hai. Cushion pehle, growth baad mein.

lessons.reflex: Ya toh turant kharch kar do, ya kisi dost ke kehne pe bina soche kahin daal do.
lessons.real_question: Is paise ko mujhe kab chahiye?
lessons.framework: Har rupee ko teen dabbon mein socho — (a) jald/emergency → safe & reachable, (b) 1–3 saal goal → alag treatment, (c) 5+ saal → yahan 'grow karun?' banta hai. Order matters: cushion pehle.
lessons.your_call: ₹10k kahan jaaye = aapka cushion + upcoming needs + horizon. 'Kya achha chal raha hai' galat compass hai. Hum jagah name nahi karte — sirf kaise choose karein.

key_terms.definition: Safe, reachable money kept only for the unexpected.
How long until you actually need a given rupee.

quiz.question: Paise ke baare mein sabse pehla sawaal kya hai?
quiz.why: Kab chahiye — yeh baaki sab decide karta hai: reachability aur growth-focus.

quiz.question: Investing shuru karne se pehle kya hona chahiye?
quiz.why: Cushion bina, pehla jhatka aapko galat waqt pe bechne pe majboor karega.

practical_action.instruction: Virtual ₹10,000 ko Jald / Mid / Long buckets mein daalo — jo ratio aaj sahi lage.
practical_action.data_needed: A real savings-account interest rate for the 'Jald' bucket.
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Kaun sa bucket sabse bada rakha — aur kyun?

lessons.tax_or_fee_note: Savings interest is taxable income in India, with a limited deduction possible. A detail, not a reason to act today. (verify current rate before relying on this)

lessons.title: Jab zindagi curveball fenke
lessons.subtitle: Why an emergency fund comes first
lessons.situation: Saturday raat. Phone haath se gira, screen chaknachoor — ya ghar mein achanak medical bill. ₹15,000 chahiye, abhi.

myth.lie: Saara paisa invested ho toh main 'aage' hoon.
myth.truth: Bina emergency fund, pehla jhatka hi aapko galat waqt pe bechne pe majboor karega.

lessons.reflex: Invested paisa nikaalo (jo us din neeche ho), ya credit card / udhaar pe chale jao.
lessons.real_question: Kya aisa paisa hai jo bina loss, bina wait — aaj mil jaaye?
lessons.framework: Emergency fund = kuch mahine ke essential kharche, alag, safe & liquid, untouched. Yeh growth ke liye nahi — peace ke liye. Investing iske baad shuru hoti hai.
lessons.your_call: 3, 6, ya zyada mahine — income stability, dependents, aur health pe depend karta hai. Aapki call.

key_terms.definition: A safe, liquid pot sized in months of essential spending.
How fast you can reach cash without a loss.

quiz.question: Kaunsa paisa sabse zyada liquid rehna chahiye?
quiz.why: Emergency ko cash aaj chahiye — reachable & penalty-free.

quiz.question: Emergency fund ka asli maqsad kya hai?
options: Bura waqt bina bechne ke sambhaalna
quiz.why: Yeh peace ke liye hai — taaki jhatke pe aapko investments galat waqt na bechne pade.

practical_action.instruction: Apna asli monthly essential kharcha daalo; app 3 aur 6 mahine ka cushion size karega.
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Aaj emergency aaye toh 24 ghante mein kitna reach kar sakte ho?

lessons.title: Drawer mein pada paisa chhota ho raha hai
lessons.subtitle: Inflation, the silent shrink
lessons.situation: Dadi ne ₹50,000 ghar pe 'safe' samajh ke 5 saal se rakhe. Note wahi, ginti wahi.

myth.lie: Cash ghar/idle mein rakhna = fully safe.
myth.truth: Volatility se safety aur inflation se safety — do bilkul alag baatein hain.

lessons.reflex: Idle cash ko permanently safe maan lena.
lessons.real_question: 5 saal baad us ₹50,000 se aap utna hi khareed paoge?
lessons.framework: Inflation daam dheere-dheere badhata hai; toh same rupees se kam milta hai. Idle 'safe' paisa chup-chaap apni buying power khota hai.
lessons.your_call: Emergency ke liye idle cash sahi; par barso idle pada long-term paisa ek quiet cost carry karta hai. Kitna idle — zaroorat se decide karo, dar se nahi.

key_terms.definition: The general rise in prices, so the same rupees buy a little less each year.
What your money can actually buy, not the rupee count.

quiz.question: Idle 'safe' cash ke saath quietly kya hota hai?
quiz.why: Number wahi, par prices badhne se woh kam khareed paata hai.

quiz.question: Volatility se safe hona kis se safe hone jaisa NAHI hai?
quiz.why: Bumpiness se bachna alag; inflation se buying power ka bachaav alag cheez hai.

practical_action.instruction: Virtual ₹50,000 pe latest real inflation apply karke 5 saal aage ki buying power dekho.
practical_action.data_needed: Latest official India CPI / retail inflation print (real).
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Kitna cash aapka 'zaroori reachable' hai vs 'bas pada hua'?

lessons.title: ₹200 ko ₹400 kaun banata hai — time
lessons.subtitle: Compounding is back-loaded
lessons.situation: Do dost. Ek ne 22 ki umar se chhota-chhota daala aur bhool gaya. Doosre ne 32 se double amount daala.

myth.lie: Investing tabhi matlab rakhta hai jab bada amount ho.
myth.truth: Time amount se bada lever hai — jaldi shuru karna > baad mein zyada daalna.

lessons.reflex: 'Abhi kam hai — baad mein zyada kama ke ek saath bada invest karunga.'
lessons.real_question: Aage kaun nikla — jisne zyada daala, ya jisne jaldi shuru kiya?
lessons.framework: Compounding = return on return. Shuru mein flat lagta hai, asli kamaal baad ke saalon mein (back-loaded). Heavy lifting time karta hai, amount nahi.
lessons.your_call: Jo abhi de sako, usse aaj shuru karo — chhota bhi chalega. Kahan point karna hai woh alag, baad ka decision.

key_terms.definition: Earning returns on both your money and the returns it already earned.
How long the money stays invested before you need it.

quiz.question: Compounding ke early saal flat kyun lagte hain?
quiz.why: Back-loaded — returns-on-returns ka snowball baad mein bada hota hai.

quiz.question: Same monthly amount — kaun aage, 25 se shuru ya 35 se?
quiz.why: Zyada time = zyada cycles — time compounding ka sabse bada lever.

practical_action.instruction: Simulator mein ₹500 ko 5, 15 aur 25 saal aage chala ke woh saal dhoondo jahan curve flat se steep hota hai.
practical_action.data_needed: A real historical index return series drives the curve (not a flat rate).
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Bend kis saal aaya — surprise hua?

lessons.tax_or_fee_note: Baar-baar bechne se tax/charges compounding todte hain. India mein equity 1 saal se zyada rakha (long-term) alag taxed hota hai. (verify current rate before relying on this)

lessons.title: Shaadi 8 mahine mein, retirement 25 saal door
lessons.subtitle: Time horizon decides treatment
lessons.situation: Aapke paas do goals, dono ke liye ₹1 lakh: behen ki shaadi 8 mahine mein, apni retirement 25 saal door.

myth.lie: Amount same hai toh treatment bhi same hona chahiye.
myth.truth: Horizon treatment decide karta hai — amount nahi.

lessons.reflex: Dono ₹1 lakh ko ek jagah, ek soch se rakhna.
lessons.real_question: Near aur far paisa same hona chahiye sirf isliye ki number same hai?
lessons.framework: Short horizon → safe & reachable (bumpiness galat waqt pe chot degi). Long horizon → bumps ride kar sakta hai, recover aur compound hone ka time hai. Isko goal bucketing kehte hain.
lessons.your_call: Har goal ko date ke hisaab se bucket karo; kahan baithe = horizon + liquidity + risk. Aapke haath mein.

key_terms.definition: Years until you actually need a specific pot.
Separating money by goal, each with its own horizon.

quiz.question: Short-horizon paise ke liye bumpiness bada problem kyun?
options: Neeche ho toh bechna pad sakta hai
quiz.why: Kam time mein dip aaya toh recover ka mauka nahi — low pe bechna padta hai.

quiz.question: Wrong-horizon ka example kaunsa hai?
options: Agle mahine ka paisa lock karna
quiz.why: Jald chahiye paisa lock karna horizon mismatch hai.

practical_action.instruction: Apne asli goals dates ke saath likho; app horizon nikaalega; virtual paise ko 'under 3 yrs' / 'over 7 yrs' mein daalo.
practical_action.data_needed: Today's date + the user's goal dates (real) to compute exact horizons.
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Kaun sa goal aap galat horizon pe treat kar rahe ho?

lessons.title: "Yeh double kar dega" — ab kya?
lessons.subtitle: The risk-return smell test
lessons.situation: WhatsApp forward — ya dost confidently: '6 mahine mein double, risk zero, guaranteed. Jaldi karo, offer close ho raha hai.'

myth.lie: High return aur zero risk ek saath mil sakte hain.
myth.truth: Zyada return ka mauka = zyada ups-and-downs. Guaranteed-high + no-risk = classic red flag.

lessons.reflex: FOMO — 'sab kama rahe honge' — aur bina soche kood jaana.
lessons.real_question: High return + zero risk + urgency — kya yeh combination real ho sakta hai?
lessons.framework: Risk–return trade-off: jahan zyada return ka mauka, wahan zyada bumpiness. Urgency aapko sochne se rokne ke liye lagayi jaati hai. Yeh sabak risk module ka darwaza hai.
lessons.your_call: Ruko. Kisi bhi cheez ko horizon, risk capacity aur diversification ke lens se judge karo — tip pe nahi, urgency pe kabhi nahi.

key_terms.definition: Higher potential return almost always comes with more ups and downs.
A promise of high return, no risk, and urgency — treat with suspicion.

quiz.question: 'Guaranteed high return, zero risk, jaldi karo' — sahi reaction?
quiz.why: High return + zero risk ek red flag hai; urgency aapko sochne se rokti hai.

quiz.question: Kisi option ko judge kaise karein?
quiz.why: Decision aapki situation se — tip ya urgency se nahi.

practical_action.instruction: App mein ek broad index ki 1-saal bumpy chaal ko ek fixed rate ke saath rakh ke dekho (real data).
practical_action.data_needed: A real 1-year index price series + a current fixed-return rate.
practical_action.reflection_prompt: Kabhi FOMO mein koi financial decision liya? kya hua?
